timing: CUDA graphs, preallocated buffers, warm resident inputs; rotated order; no locked clocks; transpose excluded

sanitizers.racecheck: RACECHECK SUMMARY: 0 hazards displayed (0 errors, 0 warnings)

contract.operation: A[M,K] @ B[N,K].T; both BF16, contiguous row-major; no implicit transpose
contract.quantization: Independent per-row/K32 E4M3 and E8M0, identical to mxtest.online_scale, not 32x32 weight scales
contract.limitations: Finite BF16 inputs; inherited exponent-254 reciprocal-to-zero behavior; N multiple64, K multiple64 (config7 K multiple128); M tails supported
contract.pipeline: 8 consumer + 4 producer warps, persistent TMA loads, register online quantization, QMMA block scale, TMA stores
contract.fp32_output: FP32 accumulation stored without BF16 rounding, in two column slices sharing the BF16 output memory budget
contract.baseline: Cached B uses the same per-row/K32 quantization; refresh+cached includes preallocated Triton B quantization; existing 32x32-weight GEMM is not the baseline
contract.integration: Experimental only; production SwiGLU/default Triton path unchanged; transpose and autograd integration excluded
